name: commit-message-limits
goal: A commit message of a repository that declares the writing limits is held to them: a subject of at most 72 characters that starts with feat:, fix:, chore: or cleanup:, and a body of at most 60 words and 400 characters. An opt-in commit-msg hook refuses a longer one before the commit exists, and verification refuses the stored messages of the verified source range, so --no-verify does not pass

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: brevity-contract.md: subject up to 72 characters with a feat:/fix:/chore:/cleanup: prefix, body with trailers up to 60 words and 400 characters, enforced by an opt-in commit-msg hook and again by verification of the stored messages of the verified range. Counting is data's shared writingLimits; the prefix rule, the hook, the service and the verification call are shell's. Criteria and proof: specification/features/planned/commit-message-limits.md.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: New: src/utils/commitMessage.ts (rules; reads a message file as Git stores it), src/services/CommitMessageService.ts (staged message; stored messages of a first-parent range; skips evidence commits and trees that do not declare the limits). Changed: hookScript (per-stage wrapper; pre-push byte-identical to b4afb74), HookInstallService (both stages, legacy status fields kept, stages added), runHooks and HooksCommand (commit-msg gate reads the file and no input), runVerify (one wrapped call adds stored-message problems to the reasons failures), hooks and explain guides, AGENTS.md, packages/reports/AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, harness.verify.json writing 1, root test:e2e list. tsc, eslint, prettier and audit pass.
